title: Nothing can be dropped on an inactive technician, and a failed drop goes back
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the build under test as a dispatcher whose role has Work Orders view and Work Orders create and edit (check: Settings > Roles & Permissions > open the role > on the Work Orders card, View and Create & Edit are both ticked. The Admin role has both).
  2. In the top bar, choose the location you test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty"). Every technician and work order below belongs to this location.
  3. Use a desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide (the display switcher only shows at 1024 px and wider).
  4. The location has these eligible technicians (examples): "ZZAUTOTEST Ana Alpha", "ZZAUTOTEST Ben Bravo", "ZZAUTOTEST Dan Delta".
    • A staff member counts as a technician when, in Settings > Staff > open the staff member > Edit Staff Member, they are Active, the Time Clock (clockable) setting is on, the role is neither Office nor Time Clock User, and they are enrolled at this location.
    • To add one: Settings > Staff > add a staff member with those settings (e.g. first name "ZZAUTOTEST Ana", last name "Alpha").
  5. How to create each work order below:
    • Work Orders > New Work Order > pick the customer (add it from the window if it does not exist, e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST Alpha Co") and any asset > Create.
    • On the work order page set Lead Technician to the technician named (leave it empty for an unassigned one).
    • Move it to the status named: a new work order starts as Estimate; approve the estimate for Approved; use the status control on the work order page for In Progress, Review (Ready for Review) and Complete; decline the estimate for Declined; Finance tab > Create Invoice for Invoiced; record a payment for the full amount for Paid. Set the lead technician before invoicing.
    • Write down each work order number as you create it (e.g. S1-801).
  6. Work orders (Approved): lead Ana — "ZZAUTOTEST Alpha Co"; lead Dan — "ZZAUTOTEST Delta Co".
  7. Then deactivate Dan: Settings > Staff > ZZAUTOTEST Dan Delta > Edit Staff Member > turn Active off > save. Dan's column stays because he still leads Delta Co.
  8. None of these technicians has a shift on the Schedule for these work orders (check the Schedule page). If a window titled "Clear … scheduled shifts?" still appears during a move, click "Keep shifts".
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders from the top menu and click the All tab.
  2. Type "ZZAUTOTEST" in Search so only your test work orders show.
  3. Click Board View in the display switcher (the design tooltip reads "Board").
  4. Find Dan's column (marked as inactive) and write down its count (1).
  5. Drag the Alpha Co card from Ana's column into Dan's column and release.
  6. Turn this computer's network off (Wi-Fi off or cable out). Leave the page open.
  7. Drag the Alpha Co card from Ana's column into Ben's column and release.
  8. Read the alert, then click its dismiss (X) button.
  9. Turn the network back on and refresh the page.
  10. Open Alpha Co and read Lead Technician.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 5: Dan's column does not accept the card. Alpha Co stays in Ana's column, Dan's count stays 1, and no lead-change message appears.
  • Step 7: the move cannot be saved. The card goes back to Ana's column and the alert reads "Failed to update lead technician, please try again."
  • Step 8: the alert stays until you dismiss it.
  • Steps 9 and 10: after the refresh Alpha Co is still in Ana's column with Lead Technician Ana Alpha.
  • If the app shows its own offline message instead of the alert, write it down. Pass on the card going back and the lead staying unchanged, and note that the alert wording could not be checked this way.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10052 (Story 9, Drag to reorder work and technician groups/columns); SV-10047 (Story 4, Reassign or unassign the lead technician); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S9-N2, S4-N5, S4-N3, S4-N8, read 8 Oct 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-N2: “Apply S4-N5’s inactive-destination restriction and S4-N3/S4-N8’s failure recovery to drag reassignment.”
  • S4-N5: “Nothing can be dropped onto an inactive technician's column/group (S2-N2, S3-N2).”
  • S4-N3: “If reassignment fails, return the card or row to its original column or group.”
  • S4-N8: “Failed reassignment shows a user-dismissible alert: “Failed to update lead technician, please try again.””
